description: This Java source file defines the AccountTransferDetails class, representing details of account transfers within the Fineract system, including transfer types, associated accounts, and related transactions.

classes.name: AccountTransferDetails
classes.description: Entity representing details of an account transfer, including source and destination accounts, transfer type, and associated transactions.

methods.name: savingsToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates an AccountTransferDetails instance for a savings-to-savings transfer.

methods.name: savingsToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Creates an AccountTransferDetails instance for a savings-to-loan transfer.

methods.name: loanTosavingsTransfer
methods.description: Creates an AccountTransferDetails instance for a loan-to-savings transfer.

methods.name: loanToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Creates an AccountTransferDetails instance for a loan-to-loan transfer.

methods.name: addAccountTransferTransaction
methods.description: Adds a transfer transaction to the account transfer details.

methods.name: updateAccountTransferStandingInstruction
methods.description: Updates the standing instruction associated with the transfer.

methods.name: accountTransferStandingInstruction
methods.description: Returns the standing instruction for the transfer.

methods.name: transferType
methods.description: Returns the transfer type as an AccountTransferType enum.

methods.name: getAccountTransferTransactions
methods.description: Returns the list of associated account transfer transactions.
